spelling_policy: Only explicit per-item forms are accepted. For W14 Q40, follow-up, followup and follow up are accepted spellings of the same noun; follow up uses two words. No general hyphen deletion, stemming or fuzzy synonym rule.
normalisation: Trim outer whitespace; collapse internal whitespace; Unicode casefold. No fuzzy spelling, automatic article deletion, plural stemming or unit deletion. Clock/numeric variants are explicit. Choice letters are case-insensitive. Two-choice items are unordered sets scored by distinct intersection.

questions.prompt: How should a timed activity be interpreted?

options.C: As proof that slower participants think more deeply

questions.explanation: Different tasks investigate different processes; duration alone is not quality.

options.B: Use the clarification process and identify the actual requirements
options.C: Ask the leader to make every substantive choice

questions.explanation: Clarification separates required work from assumptions about preferred presentation.

questions.explanation: Timing must describe the work actually produced, including any agreed support.

questions.prompt: What makes another participant's allocation advice useful?

options.B: Understanding the task and conditions behind the advice
options.C: Assuming all familiar and unfamiliar tasks need equal time

questions.explanation: An allocation depends on task demands and prior knowledge.

questions.prompt: What should the final learning note identify?

options.B: Only the phrase better time management
options.C: Every possible weakness to change immediately

questions.explanation: A concrete adjustment can be evaluated in the next attempt; useful features can be retained.
